title: Labyrinth
tagline: Thirteen hours to solve it. Plenty of time for dessert.
about: A teenager has thirteen hours to solve a goblin king's labyrinth and rescue her baby brother.
cue: Serve dessert when Sarah bites the peach.

    StartersThe worm's tea and cakeButtered toasted fruit loaf fingers with a pot of tea and milkHow to make it1 fruit loaf60g butter4 tea bags of English breakfast tea1 L boiling water200ml full cream milkWarm a teapot, add the tea bags and boiling water and brew.Toast thick slices of fruit loaf until the edges crisp.Butter generously and cut into fingers. Serve with milk on the side, like a guest in a burrow.Bog of Eternal Stench garlic dipRoast garlic beaten with cream cheese and sour cream, torn baguette to dipHow to make it2 garlic heads250g cream cheese100g sour cream1 lemon1 baguettesalt, to tasteWrap the garlic heads in foil and roast at 180°C.Squeeze out the soft cloves and beat with the cream cheese, sour cream, lemon juice and salt until smooth.Serve with torn baguette for dipping.MainsHoggle's beef and mushroom stewBeef chuck, carrots and mushrooms braised 3 hours in Worcestershire gravyHow to make it1kg beef chuck2 tbsp vegetable oil1 brown onion2 carrots250g mushrooms2 tbsp tomato paste1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce1 bunch thyme750ml beef stock1kg potatoes60g butter100ml full cream milk1 bunch parsleyDice the beef, onion and carrots and quarter the mushrooms.Brown the beef in batches in the oil, then soften the vegetables in the same pot.Stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, thyme and stock. Cover and braise at 160°C.Peel and boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.Serve the stew over the mash with chopped parsley.Masked ball lemon and thyme roast chickenThe masked ball. You have no power over meHow to make itAs written, serves 4Whole chicken rubbed with thyme butter and roasted over lemon, with crisp duck fat potatoes and a rich pan gravy.Mash 80g soft butter with thyme leaves, garlic and salt and push under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken.Put a halved lemon in the cavity.Roast at 220°C for 20 minutes, then 180°C for 50 minutes until the juices run clear, and rest 15 minutes.Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in 3 tbsp duck fat at 220°C for 50 minutes.Stir 1 tbsp flour into the tray juices, add 350ml chicken stock and simmer 5 minutes for gravy.SweetsVanilla poached peaches with mascarponePeaches poached in vanilla apple syrup, chilled and served with mascarponeHow to make it400ml apple juice200ml water100g caster sugar2 tbsp honey1 vanilla bean4 peaches250g mascarpone1 tbsp icing sugar1 packet almond biscuitsSimmer the apple juice, water, sugar, honey and split vanilla bean.Add the halved peaches and poach gently, then slip off the skins.Chill the peaches in the syrup.Beat the mascarpone with the icing sugar.Serve two halves each with mascarpone, a little syrup and crumbled almond biscuits.DrinksGoblin King's spiced apple and pear punchApple and pear juice simmered with cinnamon, star anise and orange peel, served warmHow to make it1 L cloudy apple juice500ml pear juice2 cinnamon sticks3 star anises2 strips of orange peel250ml sparkling waterPut the juices in a pot with the cinnamon, star anise and orange peel.Simmer gently so the spices come through, then strain.Serve warm in mugs with a cinnamon stick, or cool it and pour over ice, topping each glass with sparkling water.Sparkling white grape juiceLudo calls for rocks.
